summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of handling transformers with no features when using 'pandas' as output, but it may introduce behavioral regression risk and lacks additional tests.

issues.description: The change may affect the behavior of ColumnTransformer when all transformers have no features, which was not considered in the patch.
The patch does not include additional tests to verify the behavior when all transformers have no features or when there are multiple transformers with no features.
